title: More models, more familiar API paths
summary:
This week made the APIs easier to connect to, their responses more predictable, and Pollen usage easier to understand.

Perplexity Sonar and Sonar Reasoning joined as `perplexity-fast` and `perplexity-reasoning`, followed by `naughty`, an uncensored Mistral Nemo model. Claude Haiku 4.5 gained the shorter primary ID `claude`, with its old alias retained. Enter added OpenAI-compatible chat-completion and model-list paths, while text-model discovery no longer requires authentication.

GPT Image now receives requested dimensions rather than automatic sizing, and valid image sizes pass through without being rescaled before reaching a model. Flux gained safeguards against oversized requests and stale queue signals; Kontext generation and editing got an import fix; and Nanobanana lost a timeout that could cut off slower jobs. Image errors and usage estimates also became more informative.

Enter added pricing tables with estimated outputs per Pollen, then a balance view separating tier and pack Pollen alongside the combined total and daily allowance. Requests draw from tier Pollen before pack Pollen. The +$5 Pollen button was connected to checkout, and publishable-key rate limits began accounting for each request’s Pollen charge rather than simply counting requests.

Chat completions now retain the transcript and audio data returned by `openai-audio`; the simple text GET route returns plain text or raw audio as appropriate. Validation was adjusted for Sonar finish reasons and optional vision and filter fields. Enter also returns actual error messages instead of a generic failure. Text responses lost default referral links and then the ad wrapper altogether, including for streams.
